title: How Pleasant to Live in Harmony!

reflections.title: Good and Pleasant Harmony

reflect.text: Living together in harmony is both good in God's eyes and a joy for His people. This biblical oneness does not mean we will all share the exact same personal tastes. Instead, it grows when we choose the humble attitude of a servant, just like Christ. True unity and humility always go together; neither can survive without the other. When pride creeps in, harmony quickly breaks down.

The psalm compares this harmony to fragrant oil poured on Aaron's head and morning dew resting on Mount Zion. These pictures show how precious and life-giving true fellowship is. Just as oil flowed down over the priest's robes, the Holy Spirit flows from our exalted Savior to bless our everyday lives. Unity is an undeserved gift that comes through the grace of the Holy Spirit, because only His power enables us to truly love.

Our love for other believers is the real earthly sign of our love for God. We honor Him when we refuse to get pulled into worldly fighting and quarreling. Instead, we can choose to be peacemakers who give others room to grow. As we walk humbly and ask the Holy Spirit to fill our hearts, the Lord brings the lasting blessing of His life and peace into our friendships.

questions: Where might pride be causing friction in your relationships, and how can you choose humility instead?
How can you ask the Holy Spirit to help you act as a peacemaker this week?
reflections.prayer: Lord, thank You for the precious gift of harmony among Your people. Forgive our pride and keep us from foolish arguments. Fill our hearts with Your Holy Spirit so we may love one another with the humble mind of Christ. Amen.

D3.author: John Piper
D3.work: The Priceless Gift of Christian Unity
